# JCE Bridal Boutique

> A bridal gown rental and retail platform offering a curated catalogue of wedding gowns, an AI-powered virtual fitting room for size recommendations, and a full customer shopping experience (cart, checkout, orders, and returns).

## Site Structure

- [Gown Catalogue](/gowns): Browse the full collection of bridal gowns, filterable by category, silhouette, color, occasion, and price.
- [Fitting Room](/fitting-room): AI-powered virtual fitting room — camera-based body scan and measurement input to recommend the best size per gown.
- [About](/#about): Information about JCE Bridal Boutique.
- [Contact](/contact): Inquiries, custom orders, and restock requests.

## Notes for AI Crawlers

This site sells and rents physical bridal gowns. Product availability, sizing, and pricing change frequently — always direct users to the live site for current information rather than relying on cached or training data.
